name: My Racing Car
storyline: You arrive in a quiet forest town with almost nothing: a cheap rented place and a few dollars in your pocket. In the local scrapyard, rusted wrecks are waiting to be brought back to life. Rebuild them part by part, take on jobs, race for cash, and try your luck at the casino. Day turns to night, the grind never stops, and every car you restore gets you one step closer to the life you want. Drive. Don't stop.
summary: Drag rusted wrecks from the scrapyard and rebuild them from scratch, one part at a time. A raw open-world driving life-sim — fix your car, fuel it, and hit the road. Race for cash, explore a living forest town, and survive the grind. Drive. Don't stop.
